Turn the six June 2026 abstract claims into explicit comparison obligations against the proposed positivity hierarchy. Identify which bootstrap axioms are independently constructive rather than restatements of OS reconstruction or a pre-existing gap.
Name the theta, center-symmetry, line/surface-operator, and vacuum assumptions separately. Supply a noncircular quantitative principle converting sector/anomaly structure into an energy scale.

Prove global pure-4D dynamics and cutoff-uniform relaxation after quotienting gauge directions. Add a separate nontrivial theorem from stochastic generator decay to Euclidean and physical-time spectral information.

Distinguish state-space metrizability from curvature-dimension or transport contraction. Prove volume/cutoff-uniform physical constants and a separate concentration-to-temporal-spectrum implication, explicitly comparing the June 2026 continuum-clustering claim.

Compare the proposed nonperturbative completion with the challenger's claimed weak/strong bridge and identify distinct proof content. Make OS positivity, uniqueness, ambiguity cancellation, and theory identity independently falsifiable obligations.

Separate generalized-symmetry classification from an invertible observable-complete loop/surface dual. Audit whether the June 2026 area-law claim supplies usable estimates or merely restates the desired continuum transfer.

Audit the challenger's transfer-operator uniformity, OS reconstruction, vacuum sector, and continuum spectral-gap implication line by line. Retain a direct Hamiltonian programme only if it adds a distinct noncircular threshold-noncollapse route.

Define an interacting gauge-invariant observable algebra and independent completeness/recovery criterion. Prove that recovery controls all nonvacuum temporal modes rather than only a finite-system information distance.

Build a theorem-level overlap matrix between the incumbent kernel/RG gates and all six June 2026 claims. Continue the incumbent programme only where its obligations remain distinct, independently motivated, and decision-relevant after the audit.

Create an unverified-challenger collision obligation: Locate the exact theorem, hypotheses, gauge constraints, volume/coupling regime, and proof of uniformity; rule out assuming the desired gap in the starting formulation. Claim-specific rationale: A uniform transfer-operator gap directly collides with the Euclidean gap functional, the direct-Hamiltonian route, and the incumbent normalized-kernel programme; it does not by itself construct local nets, stochastic processes, or topological sectors. Counterfactual mapping test: If the claimed transfer gap were disproved while the other five claims remained live, only R02, R08, and R10 should lose this collision priority.

Create an unverified-challenger collision obligation: Check convergence domains, uniform constants, loop class, coupling regime, and whether the result reaches the continuum/asymptotically-free trajectory rather than a restricted strong-coupling model. Claim-specific rationale: The Wilson-loop area-law claim bears on the observable-inequality cone, information-curvature interpretations of confinement, and the incumbent defect/RG route, but not on process construction or representation universality alone. Counterfactual mapping test: Deleting only the area-law claim must remove its Wilson-loop comparison from R02, R07, and R10 without changing the OS or universality mappings.

Create an unverified-challenger collision obligation: Audit every scale-uniform estimate, regulator removal, tightness/existence step, defect summability bound, and theory-identity argument without importing the conclusion. Claim-specific rationale: Continuum exponential clustering materially bears on observable inequalities, stochastic-process mixing, hypocoercive decay, representation-invariant correlation transfer, Hamiltonian reconstruction, and the incumbent continuum bridge. Counterfactual mapping test: Replacing continuum clustering by a lattice-only finite-volume estimate must fail this mapping until R02, R04, R05, R06, R08, and R10 are requalified to the weaker domain.

Create an unverified-challenger collision obligation: Verify the full OS axiom package, continuum Schwinger-function construction, vacuum sector, observable density, and the exact implication from Euclidean decay to a nonzero physical Hamiltonian gap. Claim-specific rationale: A complete OS reconstruction with a Hamiltonian gap directly affects local observable-net semantics, Euclidean positivity constraints, the direct-Hamiltonian route, observable recovery/density, and the incumbent OS endpoint. Counterfactual mapping test: If OS reconstruction were conditional on an assumed gap, the mapping must remain but its effect must become a circularity audit for exactly R01, R02, R08, R09, and R10.

Create an unverified-challenger collision obligation: Define the admissible regulator class, check uniform comparison bounds and uniqueness, and establish that the limiting measure is the required pure Yang-Mills theory rather than a restricted construction. Claim-specific rationale: Regulator universality changes the representation-independent local-net route, representation-as-gauge route, direct continuum Hamiltonian route, and incumbent regulator-removal programme; it does not alone constrain topological or information mechanisms. Counterfactual mapping test: A universality theorem restricted to one lattice action must be rejected as satisfying the mapping rationale for R01, R06, R08, and R10.

Create an unverified-challenger collision obligation: Audit the weak-coupling entry theorem, asymptotic-freedom control, overlap/continuation argument, absence of phase-boundary assumptions, and equality of observables across the two constructions. Claim-specific rationale: Identification of weak- and strong-coupling constructions bears on stochastic-process identity, representation-change invariance, direct continuum Hamiltonian construction, and the incumbent basin-entry/RG bridge. Counterfactual mapping test: If the two coupling constructions agree only perturbatively, the mapping must preserve a nonperturbative identity obligation for R04, R06, R08, and R10.

Strengthen the stochastic lane's gauge-covariant renormalisation obligation and lattice-approximation interface while splitting those results sharply from its proposed relaxation-to-physical-spectrum bridge.

Replace generic process rhetoric with a concrete gauge-orbit state-space comparator and make globality, dimension/model transfer, uniform mixing, and stochastic-to-physical generator separation explicit obligations.
Supply rigorous process/orbit-space genealogy while forcing the process-first and metric lanes to state the missing 2D-to-4D, stochastic-to-physical, and concentration-to-spectrum transfers.
Ground the higher-form and loop/surface lanes in the established symmetry language, while requiring a new noncircular quantitative axiom before any mass-scale inference.
Split qualitative sector constraints from quantitative gap generation and require the higher-form lane to identify exactly which theta, symmetry, and vacuum assumptions it uses.
Give the operator-algebra and observable-reconstruction lanes a precise categorical comparator while adding an explicit nonlinear-interacting construction barrier.
Ground recovery language in an actual theorem but demote any direct Yang-Mills inference until the observable algebra, gauge quotient, continuum limit, and recovery-to-gap bridge are proved.
Retain as a rigorous massive comparator while forbidding transfer to pure Yang-Mills, regulator removal, or a Hamiltonian gap.
Compare geometric and metric language directly before claiming novelty, while retaining every unproved transfer as an open obligation.
